name: mimber-mepto
description: Mimber (Timber 2.2.2) — Mepto-integrated, jQuery-free. First slice: prepareTransition + formatMoney.

scripts.build: npm run clean && vite build && npm run build:min && npm run build:banner && npm run build:theme
scripts.build:banner: node --input-type=module -e "import fs from 'fs';const pkg=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('./package.json','utf8'));const b='/*! Mimber Mepto v'+pkg.version+' — Mepto-integrated, jQuery-free */\n';['dist/timber.esm.min.js','dist/timber.pkgd.min.js'].forEach(f=>{let c=fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8');if(!c.startsWith('/*!')){fs.writeFileSync(f,b+c);console.log('banner',f)}})"
scripts.theme:check: npx theme check --path dist/theme 2>&1 | head -n 100; echo "(use shopify theme check for 2.0; ThemeKit theme is 1.0)"
scripts.themekit:build: go build -o vendor/themekit/bin/theme ./... 2>&1 | head -n 20; echo "(needs Go; or use @shopify/themekit binary fallback)"
scripts.theme:preview:url: node -e "import fs from 'fs'; const y=fs.readFileSync('./config.yml','utf8'); const s=(y.match(/store:\s*(\S+)/)||[])[1]||process.env.THEMEKIT_STORE||'your-store.myshopify.com'; const t=(y.match(/theme_id:\s*\"?(\d+)/)||[])[1]||process.env.THEMEKIT_THEME_ID||'z'; console.log('https://'+s.replace(/^https?:\/\//,'')+'/?_ab=0&_fd=0&_sc=1&preview_theme_id='+t)"
scripts.preview: npm run build:theme && npx playwright test --grep preview
